The '''mission at Argoon''' was the first battle of the [[Battle on the Frontier]] campaign of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] at the time, began his pacification of the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]] by assessing the remnants of an abandoned manufacturing plant near the planet [[Argoon]]. Imperial forces suspected the abandoned cargo area was the result of transmissions from Rebel forces voicing their intent to destroy the loading area. Nonetheless, Thrawn intended to see this through.

==The battle==
Thrawn oversaw this operation from his flagship [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Stalwart (Victory-class)|Stalwart]], initially launching a single TIE Bomber piloted by Imperial Ace [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] to inspect the five groups of abandoned Cargo containers. Stele discovered various useful station parts among 5 of the containers, resulting in the launch of Heavy group Mule to pick up the equipment while Stele destroyed the empty containers. As the Heavy Lifters began to arrive to collect useful containers, Rebel [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] entered the area, heading for the Stalwart. TIE Fighter flight group Gamma was launched in response to the impending bombing runs, aided by TIE Bomber Alpha 1 having completed its inspections. Soon additional Rebel starships joined the battle, starting with a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transport]] [[Scouter]], then [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] [[Dragon (CR90 corvette)|Dragon]], [[Beecon]] and [[Viper (CR90 corvette)|Viper]] afterwards a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class shuttle]] [[Splinter]] arrived. The Stalwart launched additional TIE Bombers and Interceptors to counter the increasing rebel threat. The new arrivals succeeded in quelling the enemy corvettes, only to be answered by [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] and [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] emerging from hyperspace. As Imperial starfighters finished off the last of the Rebel raiders, all five [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]] from [[Mule]] had collected the containers that contained the cargo and returned to the Stalwart's hangar. A single A-wing arrived as a last ditch effort to inflict Imperial casualties, however Thrawn's mission was already complete.

==Aftermath==
Thrawn succeeded in acquiring all the materials needed to build a new space installation. Now the next step was to wipe out the Pirate stronghold in the area.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle takes place in the PC game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter''. It is Battle 3 Mission 1. The player takes control of Maarek Stele and is tasked with inspecting the containers as the primary mission objectives. The player also has the option of allowing transport group Mule to pick up the containers that are considered important and bringing them back to the Stalwart to complete their mission as a secondary objective.
